title: xInsp contract schema subset (meta-schema)
description: A schema that every file under contract/schemas/ must itself validate against. It mechanically enforces the CONSTRAINED JSON-Schema subset the xInsp contract package is allowed to use: object/array/scalar types, required, enum, const, additionalProperties, $ref/$defs within the package, and scalar range/length keywords. It BANS the combinators (anyOf/oneOf/allOf/not), conditional keywords (if/then/else, dependentSchemas), and patternProperties/propertyNames/unevaluatedProperties by omitting them from the allowed keyword set under an `additionalProperties:false` node. A schema that uses a banned keyword fails validation against this meta-schema. See contract/README.md for the prose statement of the subset and the rationale for each exclusion.

$ref.description: Local ($defs) or same-package relative reference only. External $ref out of the contract package is not part of the subset.

additionalProperties.description: Boolean or a subschema. The unknown-key POLICY is a per-message decision documented in the README: descriptive schemas of the additive-only wire default to `true` (forward-compatible); closed sub-objects may use `false`.

pattern.description: Regex on a scalar STRING value. This is `pattern` (value constraint), NOT `patternProperties` (key matching) — the latter is banned.

format.description: Annotation only (uuid / hex / date-time). Not asserted for validation; documents intent — e.g. that a string carries a 128-bit id the codegen should keep as a string, never a number.

typeValue.description: A single JSON Schema type name, or an array of them (the only supported way to say `nullable` in the subset — e.g. ["string","null"]).
